description: Resolve a US company, bank or nonprofit to its registry entity. Takes a name, ticker context or an identifier and returns the entity plus all known registry anchors (CIK, LEI, EIN, UEI, RSSD). Identifiers resolve more exactly than names: 'cik:0000936468', 'lei:...', 'ein:...', 'uei:...', 'qid:Q7240'. Returns identity only, no figures; the returned entity id works with get_facts and get_timeseries. Note the level: a bank holding company (CIK) and its operating bank (RSSD) are different entities with different balance sheets.
name: lookup_entity
title: Look up an entity
